messages:
support_alex: FYI: we're getting multiple tenant reports of p95/p99 spikes starting ~11:40 UTC. Customers seeing 5–15s completes. Logs suggest requests piling in admission queue / worker saturation. @eng_brianna @sre_chris can you triage? Repro steps from customer below.

customer_ellen: Repro: hitting batch/chat endpoint with 50 concurrent short requests. Tail latency shifted after ~11:40 — previously p99 ~600ms, now ~12s. Repro is consistent. (I shared tenant token via DM.)

support_alex: ```[INGRESS] 2024-11-03T11:41:02Z admission: queued=323 inflight=64 workers=8 throttle=on drop_rate=0.002```

eng_brianna: Looking now. Any deploys or config changes around 11:30-11:45? @deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Completed canary deploy redwood-runtime v3.4.1-canary at 11:35 UTC -> 20% traffic.

sre_chris: That's suspicious. Canary included a tweak to admission-window/min_holdback that ramps holdback faster under burst. Could be overshoot causing autoscaler to not trigger.

eng_brianna: Starting rollback of canary to validate. Also checking pool autoscale and worker metrics.

eng_brianna: Metrics: worker_cpu=98% (pool A), queue_len=3200, active_workers=8, admission_min_holdback=0.6, autoscaler_cooldown=300s. Looks like cooldown prevented scale up.

sre_chris: Workaround: bump tenant concurrency_limit and lower admission_min_holdback for tenant-xyz while we rollback.

eng_brianna: Applying patch: set concurrency_limit +50% and admission_min_holdback -> 0.20 for tenant-xyz. Patch applied at 11:58 UTC. Forcing scale +2 workers.

support_alex: Customer reports immediate improvement: p99 down to ~780ms after the patch. They're running validation load now. :thumbsup:

eng_brianna: Proceeding with full rollback of canary. Follow-up: add autoscaler cooldown override and preflight check for admission params.

eng_brianna: Runbook excerpt:
```
1) identify affected tenants: query ingress.metrics where queue_len > 1000
2) patch tenant policy: concurrency_limit, admission_min_holdback
3) force scale up: POST /infra/api/scale?pool=A&delta=+2
4) rollback canary: POST /deploy/rollback?v=3.4.1-canary
5) monitor p95/p99 for 15m
```

customer_ellen: Thanks — stable for me now. Will flag if we see more.

sre_chris: Filed infra ticket infra#4521 to enforce preflight validation for admission-window changes. We'll do a short postmortem once rollout is complete. :memo:
